title: Leak scan, redaction and query-log capture hold on the layouts reviews found
goal: The leak scan flags a prose secret assignment followed by a comma, bracket or backtick, and no longer flags an EC armor label before a camel-case repository path or in a table row with a lower-camel or digit identifier cell; url_holds_credential accepts a Windows path with an @ in a folder name; redact leaves no character of a url password holding an angle bracket, never raises on a deep or wrong-shaped cache file, and has a comment that names both armor lines; kbask keeps a coord session id and resolves a session label to the live session id; a stale feedback.ids lock is held by only one of two takers; a kb! negation stops at and, but and or; agent.run marks a run failed only on a documented signal; an ops row written by a probe in another directory never reaches the clone's spool; querylog.py check prints its redact note for every redact-gate problem; a refused query-log delivery logs its reason
